rules.hypothesis: Four related, interrupted elliptical rings share a center and openings. Test whether author repairs identify transferable changes to these relations.

protocol.purpose: Two author repairs -> explicit shared rule revision -> six matched unseen seeds. Replay/coverage are instrument diagnostics, not a quality score.
protocol.scope: 400x600; blue/orange ordinary pegs; no scrolling, destruction, animations or mechanics authoring
protocol.inference: Exploratory only. No population effect estimate or learned generator claim from two repairs.
protocol.hypothesesPerRevision: Prefer one substantive shared rule change; preserve all seeds and failures.
protocol.playPreview: Optional diagnostic with fixed hash-assigned oranges; never modifies composition.

knownDefect.instruction: Калибровка, не оценка вкуса: восстановите симметрию одного нарушенного элемента. Остальные оставьте. Если непонятно — Defer, это полезный результат.

candidates.dispositionReason: Верхние дуги нессиметричны, как и зачем играть в это непонятно.

staticChecks.limitations: Static geometry only: no prediction of fun, shot diversity or solvability.
